effects.name: Silhouette Echo

effects.name: Spotlight
effects.description: Drains colour and light from the background so the subject pops, with an optional pool of light that follows them.

effects.name: Subject Afterimage

effects.name: Subject Aura
effects.description: A soft, breathing halo of light radiating from behind the subject.

effects.name: Subject Rays

audioPixelSize.label: audioPixelSize
audioPixelSize.description: Extra block size added by the bass band

effects.name: Choppy / Frame Hold
effects.description: Drops the frame rate by holding frames (stop-motion stutter). Audio drive can make it hold longer on hits.

effects.name: Frame Echo
effects.description: Blends the last few frames into decaying ghosts of the motion. Louder drive = longer echo.

effects.name: RGB Time Offset
effects.description: Red shows now, green and blue show earlier frames, so anything that moves splits into colour.

effects.name: Slit-Scan
effects.description: Each strip of the frame shows a different moment: one edge is now, the far edge is up to 15 frames ago, so motion bends and stretches.
